Good morning, Jennifer:

We did not receive a case regarding Duane Arnold Energy Center on or around 5/18. The
most recent submission we have is from David Birnbaum which came to us on 12/11/25,
subsequently approved on 3/25/26. I checked your (Jennifer Davis) account and did not

From: Jennifer Davis <Jennifer.Davis@nrc.gov>
Sent: Monday, June 1, 2026 3:50 PM
To: Branden Scott <branden.scott@iowaeda.com>; SHPO 106 <SHPO106@IowaEDA.com>
Cc: Kim Conway <Kimberly.Conway@nrc.gov>; Williamson, Alicia <alicia.williamson@hq.doe.gov>;
Conrad, Cyler <cyler.n.conrad@pnnl.gov>
Subject: RE: RE: Duane Arnold Energy Center - Request to Reauthorize of Power Operations

Hi Branden,

Thank you for the instructions. I resubmitted the letter through E-SHPO a couple of weeks
ago (around 5/18). If you could confirm receipt, I would appreciate it.

These are different undertakings associated with the potential restart of Duane Arnold
Energy Center. As discussed in our letter, NextEra Energy Duane Arnold, LLC (NEDA) has
submitted a series of licensing and regulatory requests that seek NRC approvals to
reauthorize power operations at the Duane Arnold Energy Center. While there are partial
overlaps with DOE-EDF’s review, the NRC’s undertaking is to review the regulatory
requests associated with restarting DAEC.

The NRC’s APE is slightly different than DOE’s APE. The NRC’s APE includes lands within
the DAEC site boundary and includes a 0.5-mile buffer surrounding the site. DOE EDF’s
APE falls within the NRC’s APE. Knowing this, would you prefer that we use a different
case number?

Jennifer

Jennifer A. Davis
Senior Environmental Project Manager / Archaeologist
Environmental Technical Review Branch 1
 Office of Nuclear Material Safety and Safeguards
U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission
(301) 415-3835




From: Branden Scott <branden.scott@iowaeda.com>
Sent: Monday, May 18, 2026 8:29 AM
To: Jennifer Davis <Jennifer.Davis@nrc.gov>; SHPO 106 <SHPO106@IowaEDA.com>
Cc: Kim Conway <Kimberly.Conway@nrc.gov>; Williamson, Alicia <alicia.williamson@hq.doe.gov>;
Conrad, Cyler <cyler.n.conrad@pnnl.gov>
Subject: [External_Sender] RE: Duane Arnold Energy Center - Request to Reauthorize of Power
Operations


Good morning, Jennifer:

Anything submitted to our office for review would need to come in through our E-SHPO
portal. Here are some instructions on use:
https://opportunityiowa.gov/media/3957/download?inline Please note that we no
longer require the applicant to fill out the NADB form. If you run into a snag, let me know
and I’ll call at your convenience and walk you through it.

David Birnbaum (David.birnbaum@icf.com) opened a Section 106 case on this
undertaking (R&C 251257798) and submitted documentation on behalf of the DOE, with
DOE signed documentation of the determination of effect, with a letter dated 2/25/26 as
well as supporting archaeological/architectural investigations in accordance with 36
CFR 800.4. We sent our response to Mr. Birnbaum as well as to Molly Rooney
(molly.rooney@hq.doe.gov) and the email LPO_Environmental.hq.doe.gov. We
concurred with a finding of “No Historic Properties Affected – No Properties” on
3/25/26. I am attaching the letter we received from DOE.

It appears that DOE completed Section 106, but since you are now lead federal agency,
the responsibility now falls to you. If nothing has changed (no difference in APE, etc.),
then please reference our previous consultation with DOE (R&C 251257798). That
should help us streamline. If something did change, let us know what that change is.

With kind regards,

BRANDEN SCOTT | State Historic Preservation Office ‑ Archaeologist   ​




IOWA ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY
1963 Bell Avenue, Suite 200 | Des Moines, Iowa  50315

Subject: Duane Arnold Energy Center - Request to Reauthorize of Power Operations


   Some people who received this message don't often get email from jennifer.davis@nrc.gov. Learn why this is
   important

Good afternoon,

The U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) staff is conducting an environmental
review for a series of licensing and regulatory requests submitted by NextEra Energy
Duane Arnold, LLC (NEDA) that seek NRC approvals to reauthorize power operations at
the Duane Arnold Energy Center (DAEC). The DAEC is located along the Cedar River in
Linn County, Iowa, and is approximately 8 miles northwest of Cedar Rapids, Iowa.

The U.S. Department of Energy’s Office of Energy Dominance Financing will serve as a
cooperating agency on the environmental review to combine expertise and support
streamlining agency reviews in furtherance of the recently issued nuclear focused
Executive Orders. The NRC will be the lead Federal agency under the National
Environmental Policy Act of 1969, as amended (NEPA) and the Section 106 consultation
under the National Historic Preservation Act of 1966, as amended (NHPA). The purpose of
the attached letter is to notify your office about the NRC’s environmental review activities
and consultation activities under Section 106 of the NHPA. In accordance with 36 CFR
Section 800.8(c), the NRC intends to comply with Section 106 of the NHPA through the
NEPA process.

Branden – If I need to submit via the portal, please let me know. I was having trouble
locating instructions on how to submit.

Thank you,

Jennifer

Jennifer A. Davis
Senior Environmental Project Manager / Archaeologist
Environmental Technical Review Branch 1
Office of Nuclear Material Safety and Safeguards
U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission
(301) 415-3835
